raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Small follow-on to #58243: drop the encoder CUDA graph eligibility check that PR added to `Worker.determine_available_memory`, and let the MRV2 runner decide whether there is anything to profile. ## Claims - For MRV2, the worker always calls `profile_cudagraph_memory()`. The runner already returns 0 up front when decoder mode is `NONE` and `needs_cudagraph_capture()` is False, so the worker no longer needs its own copy of the encoder rule (`cudagraph_mm_encoder and not enforce_eager`). - No behavior change. MRV1 is unchanged. ## Validation - Pre-commit (ruff, mypy) passes. - No new tests: the runner-side early return is already covered by `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py`. ## Details The early return in the runner runs before any `gc` / `empty_cache` / KV bootstrap, so calling it unconditionally costs nothing measurable at startup. ---

files.patch:
@@ -699,20 +699,16 @@ def determine_available_memory(self) -> int:
         ):
             self.model_runner.profile_run(randomize_inputs=self.randomize_dummy_inputs)
 
-        # Profile CUDA graph memory if graphs will be captured.
+        # Profile CUDA graph memory if graphs will be captured. The V2 runner
+        # decides itself, since encoder graphs don't depend on cudagraph_mode.
         # ROCm is included: #44825 moved the profiler to
         # torch.accelerator.get_memory_info (reliable on ROCm, as used by
         # the AMD-CI mem tests), and graph_pool_handle resolves to the same
         # torch.cuda handle the live capture path already uses on ROCm.
         cudagraph_memory_estimate = 0
-        compilation_config = self.vllm_config.compilation_config
         if (current_platform.is_cuda_alike() or current_platform.is_xpu()) and (
-            compilation_config.cudagraph_mode != CUDAGraphMode.NONE
-            or (
-                self.use_v2_model_runner
-                and compilation_config.cudagraph_mm_encoder
-                and not self.model_config.enforce_eager
-            )
+            self.use_v2_model_runner
+            or self.vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode != CUDAGraphMode.NONE
         ):
             cudagraph_memory_estimate = self.model_runner.profile_cudagraph_memory()
